class.name: BoneClothSimulator3D
class.brief_description: A [SkeletonModifier3D] that sways bone chains and links them to each other.
class.description: This [SkeletonModifier3D] sways hair, skirts, capes and tails, and returns them toward the animated pose. Each chain runs from [method set_root_bone_name] down to [method set_end_bone_name]. The root bone follows the pose and the bones below it are simulated. A chain whose root bone is in an earlier chain branches from it; list the trunk before its branches. With [member link_mode] set, neighboring chains are linked at every depth. The links keep the joints at their rest distance and collide as lines, so a collision cannot pass between two chains. The values apply to every chain. Each damping curve scales its value along the chains, from [code]0.0[/code] at the root to [code]1.0[/code] at the farthest tip. Use a separate node for parts that need other values. To tune a node, start from a preset in the [b]Presets[/b] submenu of the node's toolbar menu. Set how far the chains swing first, with [member stiffness/value] and [member limit_angle/value]. Then set how soon the swaying dies out after the skeleton stops, with [member drag/value]. Lower [member inertia] last, if the cloth still reacts too much to the character's movement. Lengths, speeds and [member gravity/value] are in meters at the size the character has in its model, the scene the skeleton comes from (the skeleton's [member Node.owner]). A scale inside the model is converted, so a centimeter rig whose armature has a scale of [code]0.01[/code] takes the same values as a meter rig. A scale on the model itself scales the cloth with it, gravity included, so a scaled character moves as a scaled copy. A skeleton without an owner uses its global scale. [BoneClothCollision3D] children of this node collide with every chain, at each joint and along each bone between two joints. A chain can leave some out or take only some, with [method set_enable_all_child_collisions]. A link collides only with the collisions both of its chains take, so a collision left out of a chain never pushes that chain. The simulation runs in fixed steps of 1/60 s, at most 4 per frame. [b]Note:[/b] Most methods in this class take an [code]index[/code] parameter. This parameter specifies which chain to use (e.g. [code]chains/<index>/root_bone_name[/code]).

method.name: apply_preset
method.description: Copies the values of [param preset] to this node. The chains, [member link_mode] and the collisions are not changed. Curves are copied, not shared.

method.name: are_all_child_collisions_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all child [BoneClothCollision3D]s collide with the chain, except those in its exclude collision list.

method.name: clear_collisions
method.description: Clears the chain's collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: clear_exclude_collisions
method.description: Clears the chain's exclude collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_collision_count
method.description: Returns the number of collisions in the chain's collision list.

method.name: get_collision_path
method.description: Returns the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's collision list.

method.name: get_end_bone
method.description: Returns the end bone index of the chain.

method.name: get_end_bone_direction
method.description: Returns the tail direction of the chain's end bone.

method.name: get_end_bone_length
method.description: Returns the tail length of the chain's end bone.

method.name: get_end_bone_name
method.description: Returns the end bone name of the chain.

method.name: get_exclude_collision_count
method.description: Returns the number of collisions in the chain's exclude collision list.

method.name: get_exclude_collision_path
method.description: Returns the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's exclude collision list.

method.name: get_root_bone
method.description: Returns the root bone index of the chain.

method.name: get_root_bone_name
method.description: Returns the root bone name of the chain.

method.name: is_end_bone_extended
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the chain's end bone is extended to have a tail.

method.name: make_preset
method.description: Returns a new [BoneClothPreset] with this node's values. Curves are copied, not shared.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets the joints to the current bone pose, at rest. It is useful when the pose jumps, for example right after a call to [method AnimationPlayer.play] without blending.

method.name: set_collision_count
method.description: Sets the number of collisions in the chain's collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: set_collision_path
method.description: Sets the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]false[/code]. The node must be a child of this node.

method.name: set_enable_all_child_collisions
method.description: If [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], all child [BoneClothCollision3D]s collide with the chain, and the collisions in its exclude collision list ([method set_exclude_collision_path]) are left out. If [param enabled] is [code]false[/code], only the collisions in its collision list ([method set_collision_path]) collide with the chain. Either way the collisions run in the order of the children, not the order of a list. A collision's mirror ([member BoneClothCollision3D.mirror_bone_name]) goes with it.

method.name: set_end_bone
method.description: Sets the end bone index of the chain. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

method.name: set_end_bone_direction
method.description: Sets the tail direction of the chain's end bone, in the end bone's own axes, when [method is_end_bone_extended] is [code]true[/code]. [constant SkeletonModifier3D.BONE_DIRECTION_FROM_PARENT] points the tail the way the end bone lies from its parent at rest.

method.name: set_end_bone_length
method.description: Sets the tail length of the chain's end bone when [method is_end_bone_extended] is [code]true[/code]. [code]0.0[/code] adds no tail.

method.name: set_end_bone_name
method.description: Sets the end bone name of the chain. The end bone must be the root bone or a descendant of it.

method.name: set_exclude_collision_count
method.description: Sets the number of collisions in the chain's exclude collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_exclude_collision_path
method.description: Sets the node path of the [BoneClothCollision3D] at [param collision] in the chain's exclude collision list when [method are_all_child_collisions_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. The node must be a child of this node.

method.name: set_extend_end_bone
method.description: If [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], the chain's end bone is extended to have a tail, a joint past it, so that the end bone can rotate. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [SpringBoneSimulator3D], the end bone is extended by default, with a length of [code]0.1[/code].

method.name: set_root_bone
method.description: Sets the root bone index of the chain. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.

method.name: set_root_bone_name
method.description: Sets the root bone name of the chain. The root bone follows the pose and is not simulated.

members.member: The number of chains.
The curve that scales [member drag/value] along the chains. If not set, the scale is [code]1.0[/code].

How much of each joint's speed is lost per step, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Higher values make the swaying die out sooner after the skeleton stops, and swing a little less. Recommended values are between [code]0.1[/code] and [code]0.3[/code]. Above that, the chain settles no sooner and stays farther from the pose.
The curve that scales [member gravity/value] along the chains. If not set, the scale is [code]1.0[/code].
The direction of the gravity, in world space. Only the direction is used, not the length. It cannot be zero.

The acceleration applied to every joint in [member gravity/direction], in m/s^2. [code]9.8[/code] is the earth's gravity. [code]0.0[/code] disables it. [b]Note:[/b] Unlike [SpringBoneSimulator3D]'s gravity, this is an acceleration, not a velocity.
How much of the skeleton's movement and rotation the cloth reacts to, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. The rest moves the cloth along with the skeleton.
Softens the cloth's reaction to sudden starts and stops of the skeleton. Higher values smooth more. [code]0.0[/code] disables it. Has no effect when [member inertia] is [code]0.0[/code].
The maximum speed of each joint relative to the skeleton. A low limit weakens the push out of collisions. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
The curve that scales [member limit_angle/value] along the chains. If not set, the scale is [code]1.0[/code].

The maximum angle each bone can tilt from its animated direction, in radians. Lower values keep the chain closer to the pose and cut its overshoot after the skeleton stops. [code]0.0[/code] disables the limit. Recommended values are between [code]0.5[/code] (30 degrees) and [code]1.3[/code] (75 degrees). To draw the limits, check [b]Show Limit Angle[/b] in the node's toolbar menu.
How the chains are linked, in list order. A branch that starts below its trunk's root is not linked.

How strongly the links keep neighboring joints at their rest distance, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. At [code]0.0[/code], the links only collide. Higher values make the linked chains swing less and settle sooner. Recommended values are between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]0.5[/code]. Above that, the links change little. Has no effect when [member link_mode] is [constant LINK_MODE_NONE].
The skeleton speed above which the cloth stops reacting to more movement. Has no effect when [member inertia] is [code]0.0[/code].
The curve that scales [member radius/value] along the chains. If not set, the scale is [code]1.0[/code].
The radius of each joint against the collisions. A bone or a link uses the average radius of its two joints. Higher values keep the chain farther from the collisions.
The skeleton rotation speed above which the cloth stops reacting to more rotation, in radians per second. Has no effect when [member inertia] is [code]0.0[/code].
The curve that scales [member stiffness/value] along the chains. If not set, the scale is [code]1.0[/code].

How far each joint is pulled toward its animated position per step, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Higher values keep the chain closer to the pose and make it swing less. At [code]0.0[/code], the chain does not return to the pose. Recommended values are between [code]0.05[/code] and [code]0.2[/code]. Lower values let long hair swing more freely, but it overshoots after the skeleton stops. [b]Note:[/b] [SpringBoneSimulator3D]'s stiffness uses a different formula, so its values do not carry over.

A skeleton rotation larger than this in one frame, in radians, counts as a teleport. The cloth then continues as if the skeleton had kept its last motion. Has no effect when [member inertia] is [code]0.0[/code].
A skeleton movement farther than this in one frame counts as a teleport. The cloth then continues as if the skeleton had kept its last motion. Has no effect when [member inertia] is [code]0.0[/code].

constants.constant: Each chain is linked to the next one in the list, for a cape or a skirt open at the front.
Each chain is linked to the next one in the list, and the last to the first, for a skirt all around.
